text:
maria: Heads-up — I'm putting a proposal on the table: reduce SIEM export retention from 90d -> 30d for ephemeral/low-sensitivity indices, but add a short-lived KMS-unlock workflow for forensics. Need feedback on RBAC and incident response implications.

jason: quick Q — which indices are "low-sensitivity"? we should be explicit (api-gateway logs, worker-metrics) not auth/audit.

maria: yes, proposal lists: api-gateway, infra-metrics, build-logs (non-user-data). NOT: auth-events, admin-audit, iam-change.

tara: :eyes: ok from privacy POV only if we ensure exports scrub PII and we have an approver chain for unlocks. How do you envision the KMS step?

maria: KMS/unlock flow idea: short-lived plaintext unwrap key issued by sec on-call via ticket; key TTL 2h; unwrap action recorded in audit stream; all activity tied to JIRA/INC id.

sec-bot: Automated note: Any KMS unwrap must emit audit event with fields {requester, key_id, reason, ticket}. Logs persist to secure-audit index (retention 365d).

elaine: For RBAC: we should gate the unwrap request to a small group (sec-analysts + SOC leads). Also require MFA and ticket link. I can draft an IAM policy snippet.

ken: Oncall/ops perspective — can we make the unlock through an internal service instead of human sharing keys? E.g. call POST /kms-proxy/unlock with ticket param; service validates via OPA.

ops-engineer: yep that's better. Example flow:
```
1) Analyst opens ticket (INC-123)
2) Request triggers OPA policy check for entitlement
3) On approval, KMS-proxy mints ephemeral unwrap token (2h)
4) Token used by SIEM-export service to decrypt snapshot
```

maria: exactly. Also we need limits on how often a single ticket can be used and automatic revocation on suspicious indicators.

jason: what about vuln triage / incident response? If a vuln requires longer retention for evidence, who can escalate to keep a snapshot longer?

tara: escalation should go through sec-ops manager + legal if it's a potential breach. We should add an "investigation" flag that extends retention for that snapshot only (sealed, audit-only) for up to 90d. All changes require two approvers.

maria: good call. We'll require 2 approvers (sec manager + product security) and write a short runbook for on-call.

ken: small nit — ensure snapshots are tagged and stored in an encrypted bucket separate from normal exports. That helps enforcement and makes expiration easy.

ops-engineer: Terraform snippet for bucket ACLs we can use: 
```hcl
resource "aws_s3_bucket" "forensic_snapshots" {
  bucket = "redwood-forensics-${var.env}"
  server_side_encryption_configuration {
    rule {
      apply_server_side_encryption_by_default {
        sse_algorithm = "aws:kms"
        kms_master_key_id = var.forensics_kms_key_id
      }
    }
  }
}
```

elaine: Also require object lifecycle rule to auto-delete after X days unless object labeled `investigation: true`. Nice.

maria: RBAC proposal:
- default: no access to forensic snapshots
- sec-analyst role: can request unlock via proxy
- sec-manager + product-security: can approve investigation extension
- oncall-rotation: notification gets posted to incident channel

jason: sounds sound. Can we add automated alerts for repeated unwraps on same ticket (threat signal)?

sec-bot: Rule suggestion: alert if unwrap_count(ticket) > 3 in 24h OR if unwraps_from_multiple_actors(ticket) > 1. Send to #incidents and create P1 if thresholds exceeded.

tara: one more: document the privacy justification for reducing default retention to 30d, include cost savings estimate and compliance notes (GDPR data minimization). I'll draft that.

maria: next steps:
- Elaine: IAM policy + lifecycle rules (ETA 2d)
- Ken/Ops: KMS-proxy design + OPA policies (ETA 4d)
- Tara: privacy & escalation wording (ETA 3d)
- Jason: add monitoring/alerting thresholds to detection rules (ETA 2d)

ops-engineer: I'll spin up a PoC for the proxy and post details.

oncall-bot: NOTE: If this affects on-call workflows, please update the playbooks in /docs/oncall within 48h of change.

maria: Thanks all — I'll collect PRs and we'll run a tabletop next week to exercise the unlock + investigation flow. :raised_hands:

jason: :thumbsup:
